francorLidar: Blocks for the DFRobot Matrix LiDAR distance sensor.
francorLidar.direction: The direction the sensor suggests to pass an obstacle. "free" without a measurement.
francorLidar.distance:
Distance to the nearest obstacle in mm.
In the first seconds after "start LiDAR" and without a sensor the value is 9999.
francorLidar.isDirection: A direction, to compare with "avoid direction".
francorLidar.setAvoidDistance:
Distance at which the sensor starts to suggest a direction (100 to 500 mm).
On the Maqueen use 200 at most, otherwise the sensor sees the floor.
francorLidar.start:
Switches the LiDAR on. It keeps measuring in the background, your program goes on at once.
In the first seconds and without a sensor, the distance is 9999.
francorMaqueen: Blocks for the DFRobot Maqueen Plus V3/V2 robot.
francorMaqueen.ambientLight:
Brightness measured by the ambient light sensors.
With both sides, gives the average.
francorMaqueen.atCrossroad: What the robot does at a crossroad (left, right and straight).
francorMaqueen.atLeftOrStraight: What the robot does where it can turn left or go straight.
francorMaqueen.atRightOrStraight: What the robot does where it can turn right or go straight.
francorMaqueen.atTJunction: What the robot does at a T-junction (left and right).
francorMaqueen.brightness: Sets how bright the lights underneath are.
francorMaqueen.crossingsCounted: How many crossings the robot has seen so far.
francorMaqueen.drive: Drives the left and right wheel. Negative values drive backwards.
francorMaqueen.driveBoth: Drives both wheels at the same speed. Negative values drive backwards.
francorMaqueen.driveDistance: Drives an exact distance with the board's PID controller.
francorMaqueen.driveDistance|param|wait: wait until the move is done, or continue at once
francorMaqueen.driveV2: Drives the left and right wheel (V2). Negative values drive backwards.
francorMaqueen.driveV2|param|left: speed of the left wheel in percent, eg: 50
francorMaqueen.driveV2|param|right: speed of the right wheel in percent, eg: 50
francorMaqueen.drive|param|left: speed of the left wheel in percent, eg: 50
francorMaqueen.drive|param|right: speed of the right wheel in percent, eg: 50
francorMaqueen.headlight: Sets the colour of a headlight.
francorMaqueen.isJunction: A junction type, to compare with "junction seen".
francorMaqueen.junction: The junction the line sensors see right now (0 = none). Compare it with a junction block.
francorMaqueen.lightsOff: Turns all lights off: the four underneath and both headlights.
francorMaqueen.linePosition:
Where the line is: from -2 (far right) to 2 (far left), 0 = centered.
Positive = line on the left. 100 = no line seen.
francorMaqueen.onCrossing:
Runs once when the robot reaches the crossing with this number.
Counting starts at the start (or at "reset crossing counter").
francorMaqueen.patrol:
Switches the board's built-in line following on or off.
"off" also deletes the board's crossing rules: after "on" the default rules apply again.
francorMaqueen.patrolSpeed: Sets the speed of the built-in line following.
francorMaqueen.pidStop: Stops a running drive or turn move.
francorMaqueen.redLed: Turns a red LED on the front on or off (V2).
francorMaqueen.rgb: Mixes a colour from red, green and blue.
francorMaqueen.seesLine: True if the line sensor sees the black line.
francorMaqueen.sensorRaw: Raw brightness value of a line sensor.
francorMaqueen.setLight: Sets one of the four lights underneath, or all of them.
francorMaqueen.start:
Resets the Maqueen Plus V3 board and waits until it answers.
Shows a check mark when ready.
francorMaqueen.startV2:
Starts the Maqueen Plus V2 and waits until it answers.
Shows a check mark when ready.
francorMaqueen.turn:
Turns on the spot by an exact angle with the board's PID controller.
Positive angles turn clockwise, negative angles counter-clockwise.
francorMaqueen.turn|param|wait: wait until the move is done, or continue at once
francorMaqueen.ultrasonic: Measures the distance with the ultrasonic sensor in cm (V2). Gives 0 if nothing is seen.
francorMaqueen.version: Firmware version of the board as text.
francorMaqueen.wheelSpeed:
Speed of a wheel in centimetres per second.
With "both", gives the average.
